title.zh: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
title.en: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations

current_state.zh: The Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against Kalshi, holding that its sports-related event contracts are not swaps and are therefore subject to state gaming regulations instead of CFTC oversight, adding to a growing circuit split that may push the issue to the Supreme Court.
current_state.en: The Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against Kalshi, holding that its sports-related event contracts are not swaps and are therefore subject to state gaming regulations instead of CFTC oversight, adding to a growing circuit split that may push the issue to the Supreme Court.
